Standing, staying, abiding, being, existing &.c.; तत्रस्थ, अङ्कस्थ, प्रकृतिस्थ, तटस्थ q. q. v. v.

To stay, abide, dwell, live; ग्रामे or गृहे तिष्ठति

(Ātm.) To resort or go to (as an umpire), be guided by the advice of; संशय्य कर्णादिषु तिष्ठते यः
